verdict.rationale: The docs imply an official Python client: the getting-started flow sets up a Python project with Chroma, and the docs describe client methods `.get` and `.query`. However, no item explicitly names official SDKs, lists supported languages, or links SDK reference docs. The OpenAPI spec is only a building block for constructing clients, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation, coverage of multiple languages (e.g., JS/TS), SDK reference/versioning details, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: In this directory create a new Python project with Chroma set up.
.get and .query can handle where_document search combined with metadata filtering
You can query the collection with a list of query texts, and Chroma will return the n most similar results.
